description: iOS health & workout tracker with simple task management. Combines HealthKit metrics, active workout logging, and a minimal task list.

icons.rule: Never use emojis. Always use icons from @expo/vector-icons.

userStories.title: Project setup with Expo and TypeScript

userStories.title: Validation pipeline with Lefthook
userStories.description: Configure oxlint, oxfmt, vitest, TypeScript checks, and npm audit with Lefthook pre-commit hooks
acceptanceCriteria: oxlint installed and configured with recommended rules
oxfmt installed and configured for TypeScript/TSX files
vitest installed with initial config (vitest.config.ts)
lefthook.yml configures pre-commit hooks for all checks
npm run check runs: oxfmt --check, oxlint, tsc --noEmit, vitest run, npm audit
npm run fix runs: oxfmt and oxlint --fix
Pre-commit hook blocks commits unless all checks pass
package.json postinstall runs lefthook install
All existing code passes validation pipeline
userStories.notes: Ralph-loop ready: nothing commits unless check exits 0
